title: SAGE: Sense-Aligned Multimodal Grounding Evaluation with Gloss-Augmented Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.31838v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper introduces Sense-Aligned Grounding Evaluation (SAGE), a unified 10-candidate image-selection benchmark that reformulates VWSD, VerSe, and WikiDiverse into a shared term-centric protocol covering noun-, verb-, and entity-centered grounding. SAGE includes confusable hard negatives and a context-swapped VerSe diagnostic to probe target-term grounding beyond direct caption--image compatibility. We further propose Gloss-Augmented Reasoning (GAR), a training-free framework combining definition grounding with constraint-guided semantic verification. Experiments show that strong VWSD performance does not transfer uniformly across grounding settings. With Gemma3-12B, definition augmentation improves all three subsets, while constraint-guided reasoning improves VWSD and yields particularly strong gains on VerSe, but is less effective on WikiDiverse. Combining the two signals achieves the best macro-average performance, improving Hits@1

translated_title: SAGE：基于释义增强推理的词义对齐多模态定位评估
translated_abstract: 本文提出了词义对齐定位评估基准SAGE，这是一个统一的10候选图像选择基准，将VWSD、VerSe和WikiDiverse重新整合为共享的以词语为中心的评估协议，涵盖以名词、动词和实体为中心的定位任务。SAGE包含易混淆的困难负样本以及一个上下文交换的VerSe诊断任务，用以探究超越直接图文兼容性的目标词语定位能力。我们进一步提出了释义增强推理（GAR），这是一个免训练框架，将定义定位与约束引导的语义验证相结合。实验表明，模型在VWSD上的强劲表现并不能均匀迁移到其他定位设置中。使用Gemma3-12B模型时，定义增强提升了所有三个子集的性能，而约束引导推理提升了VWSD的表现，并在VerSe上取得了尤为显著的增益，但在WikiDiverse上效果较差。将两种信号结合使用实现了最佳的宏观平均性能，提升了Hits@1指标。
tldr: 本文提出统一的多模态词义定位评估基准SAGE，并引入免训练的释义增强推理框架GAR，通过结合定义定位与约束引导语义验证，显著提升了多模态大模型在不同定位任务上的词义消歧性能。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SAGE, a unified multimodal grounding evaluation benchmark, and proposes a training-free Gloss-Augmented Reasoning (GAR) framework that combines definition grounding with constraint-guided semantic verification, significantly improving multimodal LLMs' word-sense grounding performance across diverse grounding tasks.
